subject: Anyone coming to NACCB in Vancouver?

messages.subject: Anyone coming to NACCB in Vancouver?
parts:
Hello Wallace users and super-users!

Wallace dev team members Andrea Paz (paz.an...@gmail.com) and Daniel Lopez (dlopez...@amnh.org) will be leading a Wallace workshop at the North American Congress for Conservation Biology in a few weeks in Vancouver, B.C. Canada - we were wondering if any other wallace users or super-users (especially educators) will also be attending the conference?  If so please let them know (emails above), it would be great to connect, and maybe even include you in the workshop if you're interested.
